about.title: Welcome to Marsol Technologies
about.description: Comes with more than 30 years of experience working with Oil & Gas and Offshore Industries. Specialized in helideck fire suppression, we are expanding our reach across industries and regions.

diffs.description: Our DiFFS (Deck Integrated Fire Fighting Systems) removes the issues and concerns of mechanical failure. Fully certified and recognized by the likes of UL, ABS, CAA and USCG.

globalPresence.title: Global Presence
globalPresence.description: Our operations across the USA, UAE and India provide customers with local sales, engineering and support.

hero.title: Why Work With Us
hero.description: MARSOL Technologies is focused on delivering advanced fire protection and safety solutions for demanding industries around the world.

why.card1Body: The team of people behind, in the midst and in front of the company, have a wealth of knowledge and experience garnered from over 30 years of working within the Oil & Gas and Off-shore industries.
why.card2Body: All of our products and systems are subjected to rigorous testing and certification processes that ensure industry compliance to the highest level possible, giving you unprecedented assurance as to what MARSOL is all about.
why.card3Body: Our leadership team passionately believe in the key principle that our customer always comes first. We have an uncompromising commitment to our clients and view customer satisfaction as our highest priority.

since.label: Since
since.p1: Our particular specialisms primarily relate to the aspects of foam fire suppression – designing and deploying next-gen products and systems that ensure the best practice and the safest possible environment is achieved.
since.p2Prefix: MARSOL products and systems are unique – not just for the sake of it – but because in being so, they provide enhanced performance and ultimately –
since.p3: With our Head Office located in USA and offices in UAE and Singapore, we are well positioned to coordinate and react to the demands and requirements of this great global industry we are proud to be a part of.

associations.title: Industry Connected
associations.body: MARSOL is proud to be part of the global fire protection and safety industry, working alongside professionals and organizations committed to improving safety standards.

qhse.title: Quality, Health, Safety & Environment
qhse.philosophyQuote: “To get it right the first time, every time and strive to exceed customer expectation”.
qhse.body2: Marsol regards the promotion of Health, Safety and Environment measures as a mutual objective for management and employees at all levels.
qhse.body3: Marsol has an integrated management system accredited by TUV Rheinland.
